purpose: Presentation adapter proposal; not a replacement citation schema or publication validator
registryRule: Resolve claimIds and evidenceIds through shared immutable registries; do not duplicate editable claim prose per template.

mappings.author: evidence[].attribution.authorLabel
mappings.speaker: evidence[].attribution.speakerLabel
mappings.locator: evidence[].citation.locator; anchor offsets remain transcription offsets
mappings.dependencies: collection inputs/integrity plus verified assembly dependency sidecar

sidecarsRequired.conflict: explicit conflict/issue record; not an enum in v1 review
sidecarsRequired.stale: dependency verification or citation.review.state; never inferred from age alone
sidecarsRequired.publication: separate output-use eligibility and editorial review; private v1 remains draft
sidecarsRequired.relationship: explicit reference/source-location sidecar; do not invent v1 basis values
sidecarsRequired.catalogueOnly: crosswalk reader availability; v1 reader alone cannot distinguish unavailable states
sidecarsRequired.bibleReference: existing canonical Bible reference input, never derived solely from similarity

rules.null: Render unknown/not recorded; do not infer dates, translator or locator
rules.stale: Suppress current answer/synthesis; retain evidence as stale for inspection; require revalidation
rules.conflict: Quarantine affected assertion/verse binding; present issue and alternatives without choosing a winner
rules.candidate: No approved answer or endorsement label
rules.reviewed: Show kind and limited scope; never imply doctrinal or public approval
rules.reading: Enable only an existing permitted on-site route; external source link in footer only
rules.missingRequired: Do not render as complete; explicit incomplete-data state
rules.longContent: Wrap identifiers; do not ellipsize quotations, attribution, limitations or source locators; details may collapse on screen and expand for print

fieldTypes.id: string; presentation-scoped, not a new canonical identity
fieldTypes.templateId: enum: answer, passage, comparison, dossier, lesson
fieldTypes.title: nonempty string
fieldTypes.evidenceIds: array of existing evidence IDs; unresolved references block complete rendering
fieldTypes.claimIds: array of registry keys; claim text resolved centrally
fieldTypes.synthetic: boolean; true for every gallery fixture
fieldTypes.*ClaimIds: array of shared claim registry keys
fieldTypes.qualifications: array of attributed text or claim references
fieldTypes.objections: array of attributed objection/reply references; unknown speaker explicit
fieldTypes.positions: array of author/work/edition references and claim IDs
fieldTypes.dateRoles: object of distinct source-bound dates or null
fieldTypes.sequence: ordered array of learning prompts and evidence references
fieldTypes.relationship: explicit-exposition, explicit-citation, chapter-candidate or unresolved; presentation-sidecar only
fieldTypes.bibleTextState: omitted, available or unavailable; do not invent Scripture text
fieldTypes.relatedReadingIds: optional array of verified on-site reader sidecar IDs
fieldTypes.otherTextFields: string or explicitly labelled draft; unknown optional metadata null
